name: Taxi Genmutan ~Strange World Act. 2~
original_name: ＴＡＸＩ幻夢譚 ～ストレンジ・ワールド Act. 2～
source:
Hero is a taxi driver. He chooses which passenger to take on a ride and can opt to interfere in his client's affairs at any moment.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-february-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名出租车司机。他可以自行选择搭载哪名乘客，也能随时决定是否介入客人的私事。
